name: Tune Up!!
source:
The protagonist, who has been losing every single job-hunting battle, suddenly experiences two strokes of luck.

One is being selected for the product development department (his dream job) of a top-class general electronics manufacturer founded by a distant relative. 

The other is winning a large sum of money (1 million yen!) from a lottery ticket he bought on a whim. 

While basking in this joy, the protagonist searches the internet for how other people who have suddenly come into a large sum of money are spending it, and his eyes fall upon a sales page for an elaborate doll... He is captivated by the amazing quality of the high-end doll, which he has never seen before, and the next moment he decides to buy it.

As soon as the doll arrives, the protagonist's imagination runs wild and he enjoys himself. 

However, after a while he begins to feel a little bored with a doll that "doesn't move and doesn't talk"...

But the appearance and craftsmanship itself are "to the protagonist's liking", so he doesn't want to let it go... 

While thinking about this, the protagonist comes up with an outrageous idea. If they "don't move and don't talk," then the solution is to make them "move and talk".

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/23807/]Getchu[/url]]
